title: Placement
core_thesis: Logical boundaries between neural policies and deterministic safety enforcers collapse on physical silicon unless contention for shared resources like power rails, clock trees, and memory buses is rigorously measured and budgeted under worst-case concurrent loads.
pedagogical_strengths: Successfully grounds abstract software architecture concepts in concrete physical constraints like voltage drops and thermal throttling.
Provides a clear, actionable checklist (the Placement Deliverable Quintet) for verifying physical isolation.

student_friction_points.point: The abrupt mention of '12 percent channel availability required for high-temperature DRAM refresh cycles' assumes prior knowledge of how thermal states degrade DRAM retention times.
The transition into 'Windowed watchdog timers and execution liveness' breaks the chapter's focus on shared spatial resources by abruptly pivoting to temporal execution monitoring.

established_budgets_and_laws: Loaded enforcement latency bound ($P_{99.99}$) under concurrent maximum-bandwidth DMA transfers.
Power rail transient limits ($L \, dI/dt$) to prevent voltage drops and subsequent DVFS clock throttling.
imported_prerequisites: Runtime safety filters and Control Barrier Functions (CBFs).
Lock-free seqlocks and monotonic version counters for cross-boundary communication.
exported_concepts: The Placement Deliverable Quintet for evaluating physical silicon interference.
Common-mode failure vectors in heterogeneous SoCs (shared PLLs, reset lines, heat sinks).

surgical_edits.target_text: Every shared resource has multiple claimants; a number that does not specify its competition is not a systems number.
surgical_edits.improved_text: Every shared physical resource has multiple claimants; a utilization metric that ignores concurrent competition is functionally meaningless.

surgical_edits.target_text: This physical isolation collapses without rigorous measurement and bounding of memory bus contention, crossbar arbitration, and power rail transients, which prevents high-bandwidth tensor bursts from starving microsecond enforcement loops.
surgical_edits.improved_text: This physical isolation collapses unless engineers rigorously measure and bound memory bus contention, crossbar arbitration, and power transients. These strict budgets prevent high-bandwidth tensor bursts from starving microsecond safety loops.

open_thematic_threads_for_part: How does the system arbitrate operational authority and safely manage human intervention when physical reality diverges from the fully integrated, measured autonomous pipeline?
